meta.name: offensive-wpa2-psk
meta.description: WPA/WPA2-PSK attack methodology — four-way handshake capture via targeted deauthentication, PMKID attacks (no client required), hcxdumptool / hcxpcapngtool conversion to hashcat hc22000 format, GPU-accelerated cracking with dictionary, mask, and rule-based attacks, vendor default-PSK generators (UPC, Sky, BT, etc.), 802.11r FT key cracking, opportunistic key cache analysis, and signal-level optimization. Use when the in-scope network is WPA/WPA2 Personal — the most common consumer/SMB encryption mode.

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对WPA/WPA2-PSK网络进行渗透测试或密码恢复。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to perform penetration testing or password recovery on WPA/WPA2-PSK networks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会指导你通过 PMKID 攻击或四次握手捕获来破解 WPA/WPA2-PSK 密码，包括转换哈希格式、GPU 加速破解、字典/掩码/规则攻击，以及厂商默认密码生成。
howto.when: 当目标网络是 WPA/WPA2-Personal 加密模式（最常见的消费/SMB 网络）时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 PMKID 攻击破解这个 Wi-Fi 的密码。
say.note: Claude 会给出 PMKID 捕获和转换命令。

say.text: 捕获到四次握手后，用 rockyou 字典和 OneRule 规则破解。
say.note: Claude 会提供 hashcat 命令。

say.text: 字典破解失败，试试 10 位数字掩码攻击。
say.note: Claude 会给出掩码攻击命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through PMKID attack or four-way handshake capture to crack WPA/WPA2-PSK passwords, including hash format conversion, GPU-accelerated cracking with dictionary/mask/rule attacks, and vendor default-PSK generators.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the target network uses WPA/WPA2-Personal encryption (most common consumer/SMB mode).

say_en.text: Help me crack this Wi-Fi password using PMKID attack.
say_en.note: Claude will provide PMKID capture and conversion commands.

say_en.text: After capturing the handshake, crack with rockyou dictionary and OneRule.

say_en.note: Claude will provide mask attack command.
